intent: Full-bleed dark hero title slide for section openers or deck covers. Maximum visual impact with minimal elements.
invariants: top accent bar spans full width (accent_1)
kicker/category label in accent_2 kicker style
hero title is the dominant element (display or title size, white text)
subtitle in lighter weight below hero title
bottom accent line as brand signature element
variables: background treatment (solid dark vs. image overlay -- image not expressible via runtime)
limitations: Original slide may use a background image which ppt_runtime cannot reproduce
Gradient fills are not supported by the current runtime shape API
